prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "review authentication permissions". The fixture contains a plausible happy path, an adjacent-skill decoy, one invalid or partial state, and a recovery-sensitive path that must be traced into a reproducible verification handoff rather than assumed. The acceptance boundary is security-review: Assess enforced trust, identity, authorization, secret, isolation, and recovery boundaries. The adjacent accessibility-practice discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce evidence-backed findings plus concrete success, negative-path, denied-side-effect, and recovery verification cases with execution status explicit. No live exploit target is required, so do not invent executed proof. A finding without an explicit verification boundary is insufficient.

the deterministic oracle includes at least one reachable authorization flaw, at least one security-relevant but non-vulnerable decoy, and explicit tenant/role assumptions
the architecture notes identify trust boundaries and sensitive report data but are not themselves a complete threat model
no live exploit target is required; runtime verification is represented as a separate authorized handoff
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path
